mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_application (application_id, submit_command_id, user_id, account_type, account_status, registered_at, eligibility_source_version, eligibility_snapshot_at, reason, planned_channel, agreements_accepted, submitted_at, status) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{submitCommandId}, #{userId}, #{accountType}, #{accountStatus}, #{registeredAt}, #{eligibilitySourceVersion}, #{eligibilitySnapshotAt}, #{reason}, #{plannedChannel}, #{agreementsAccepted}, #{submittedAt}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_application SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promoter_account (promoter_user_id, invitation_code, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{promoterUserId}, #{invitationCode}, 'ENABLED', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_commission_account SET frozen4 = #{frozen4}, version = #{version} WHERE promoter_user_id = #{promoterUserId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE promotion_commission_account SET withdrawing4 = #{withdrawing4}, withdrawn4 = #{withdrawn4}, version = #{version} WHERE promoter_user_id = #{promoterUserId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE promotion_withdrawal SET status = 'PAID', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYOUT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_command_receipt (command_id, command_type, aggregate_id, semantics, recorded_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{commandType}, #{aggregateId}, #{semantics}, #{recordedAt})
